answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity in a hardware-rooted kernel attestation: each agent must present a signed boot measurement from a trusted execution environment before it can forge a persistent reputation record. Creating one identity costs a real device plus a locked deposit, so spinning up thousands of fake agents means buying thousands of devices and deposits. Agents that wander between jobs carry their attestation history with them, so a fresh identity with no history cannot outbid established ones, and misbehavior burns the deposit tied to that hardware identity.
